主要内容: On August 17, 2018, the Board of Directors and the Compensation Committee of DISH Network Corporation approved a long-term, performance-based stock incentive plan under DISH’s 2009 Stock Incentive Plan. The 2019 LTIP aims to align the interests of DISH and its stockholders by rewarding key employees with financial incentives through equity participation upon achieving specified long-term business objectives. Eligible employees include executive officers, senior vice presidents, vice presidents, and director-level employees. On August 23, 2018, DISH Network Corporation announced that employees participating in the 2019 LTIP will receive a one-time award of an option to purchase a specified number of shares of Class A common stock. The exercise price per share will be equal to the closing price of the Class A common stock on the date of grant or the last trading day prior to the date of grant. Awards will initially be granted under the 2019 LTIP as of October 1, 2018. The options will vest based on DISH’s achievement prior to December 31, 2023, of certain performance criteria determined by the Committee.
